page.overview:
Who is Steven Maranville?

Captain Steven Maranville was a male Starfleet officer in the 23rd century. He was the commanding officer of the in the 2250s.

In 2256, he was killed when his starship was destroyed during the Battle of the Binary Stars. He was described as being one of the finest captains by the Klingon Voq, who was Lieutenant Ash Tyler, a Human who served under him. ()
